question.text: Under SEBI (Investment Advisers) Regulations, 2013, what is the maximum fee that can be charged under the Assets Under Advice (AUA) mode per annum per client?

explanation.text: The Logic: The maximum fee under the AUA mode shall not exceed 2.5% of AUA per annum per client across all services offered by the Investment Adviser. The Trap: The 1% and 1.5% figures may appear plausible but are incorrect. The alternative Fixed Fee mode is capped at Rs.1,25,000 per annum per client. Note: Two parallel caps exist — 2.5% of AUA per annum per client under the AUA mode and Rs.1,25,000 per annum per client under the Fixed Fee mode.
